authority: Existing Goal86 run: read source, synthetic local reproduction, bounded read-only investigator, sanitized evidence and reviewed local evidence commit. No new runtime/native dependency approved.
invariant: Replacement must preserve applicable mode, owner/group and ACL restrictions before writing or publishing sensitive bytes, or fail closed without altering the original. Atomicity and hard-linked-peer independence remain required.

reproduction.classification: Built-source helper and CLI reproduction; NOT installed-package qualification
recipe: In an owned /private/tmp root, create synthetic regular files under umask022. For each atomic helper, test a0600 file; a0644 file with macOS named-user nobody deny-read ACL; and a0644 file with an alternate supplementary group.

Create a hard-linked peer before each helper invocation. Capture mode/uid/gid and native ls -dlen ACL output before and after replacement; instrument fs.writeFileSync's open descriptor to inspect mode/ownership before synthetic content writes.
Initialize a separate disposable graph through built dist/cli.js init --graph-only; create task1; chmod its node0600; run task update task1 --priority2; inspect metadata.
Assert no fixture escape and preserve each peer's original content/metadata. Restore the process umask and remove only the exact owned mkdtemp roots.

review.result: Confirmed both helper sinks and task/goal/format/selection/cache callers; explicit0600 journal requests, mode-preserving mirrors and hardlink controls must remain. No candidate patch or candidate review exists.

design_gate.existing_contract: README and package.json promise zero third-party runtime dependencies; current implementation is TypeScript/Node. macOS/Linux acceptance is mandatory; Windows remains unqualified.
design_gate.finding: Node's inspected supported public filesystem surface provides mode/uid/gid operations but no portable ACL interface. libuv1.52.1 copyfile copies mode/data and ignores fchown failure; it does not establish complete ACL-preserving replacement. This is source analysis, not a proof that every possible implementation is unavailable.
rejected_shortcuts: Mode-only preservation leaves demonstrated ACL and group failures unresolved.
In-place overwrite sacrifices atomic replacement and modifies hard-linked peers.
Post-rename chmod/chown exposes content before protection and can fail after replacing the original.
Path rechecks alone do not resolve separately tracked Bug47 ancestor-substitution races.
design_gate.question: May mdkg add a narrowly scoped OS-native filesystem layer, with explicit build/package/platform qualification, to preserve ACL/ownership and provide descriptor-anchored containment?
design_gate.recommendation: Approve a bounded native-layer design and feasibility proof first, then settle distribution and supported fallback behavior before implementation. Keep the existing no-waiver security invariant. Do not install or add a dependency without that architecture approval.
design_gate.alternative: A capability-checked platform-tool bridge may avoid distributing native binaries, but makes system tools part of the runtime contract, needs fail-closed behavior when unavailable and adds performance/portability costs. It is not yet qualified and is not automatically authorized.
design_gate.related: root:bug-47 has the same shared filesystem boundary, but its reproduction and remediation remain a separate finding, not completed by this investigation.
